narrative:
Standing still costs money. On directional bands built from Sport Holding's own data, the value at stake is about NOK 41M a year net of Snowflake run cost (range NOK 30–55M), or about NOK 3.4M a month of waiting.

A 12-week Close + Stockout pilot costs an indicative NOK 0.9–1.3M. The annual Snowflake run cost is estimated at NOK 0.9–1.5M at list price.

signals.title: October close at WD+6 — September took WD+11 on Business Central
signals.source: SDP Month-End Close Control Tower — 12 close feeds, October 2026
signals.excerpt: September was the first close on Business Central: the BC API timed out under month-end volume and finance rebuilt the books from the Data Lake by hand over three days. October has 96.8% of records landed and 93.8% auto-matched on NOK 1,357M under close.

signals.title: Stockouts cost NOK 23.8M of gross margin YTD
signals.source: SDP lost-sales model — POS demand vs on-shelf availability, Jan–Sep 2026
signals.excerpt: Lost sales from stockouts are NOK 64.2M YTD (NOK 23.8M gross margin): Intersport NOK 15.0M, Sport 1 NOK 6.4M, Anton Sport NOK 2.4M of margin. On-shelf availability is 93.4% against a 96% target.
